children.title: Prepare run
children.instructions: Read the project bridge, create the run through xc-create-run, validate requested feature IDs without creating features, determine and validate run.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, and record the requested scope.
children.deliverables: An authoritative run directory and explicit feature associations.
children.acceptance: The run is independent, feature associations are explicit, run.document_language is set before any document write, and no unmanaged feature directory was created.

children.title: Approve run solution
children.instructions: Present the selected change solution, baseline impact, implementation strategy, verification strategy, and unresolved decisions. Record approval or add revision nodes.
children.deliverables: An approval decision or explicit revision work.
children.acceptance: Implementation cannot proceed on a material unresolved solution decision.

children.title: Finalize ordinary run
children.instructions: Confirm the run result, declared artifacts, feature baseline synchronization, code provenance, and residual risks, then close the run.
children.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked run with durable evidence.
children.acceptance: The runtime tree and context documents accurately describe the run outcome.
